messages:
Elaine: Quick follow-up on the RFC for the dashlet query adapter. Proposal: phased cutover for SubqueryAdapter v2. Split the adapter from the renderer, keep auth checks upstream, and run a 10% canary for 24h. Thoughts?

Sam: +1. What's the plan for per-tenant cache keys when the adapter changes shape?

Marta: Cache keys need to include adapter_version and a short subquery_shape hash. Otherwise invalidation and hit rate will tank after cutover.

DevX Josh: Agree. Operationally we should gate with a feature flag: `dashlet.adapter.v2` and a runtime toggle in the console so SRE can flip quickly.

Elaine: Also need to decide RBAC boundary: validate permissions at the gateway or inside the adapter? My preference: gateway asserts capability token and injects a minimal capability mask in headers so adapters don't repeat expensive checks.

Sam: That reduces per-adapter auth calls but increases header surface area. Can we avoid leaking role names? Suggest we send an HMAC-protected capability blob: `X-Dash-Cap: cap_v1:<hmac>` and validate HMAC in adapters.

Marta: Perf note: v2 will break one logical widget into multiple subqueries. We should add an optional `X-Batch-Id` header so the query layer can coalesce identical subqueries within a short window.

infra-bot: deploy note: starting canary deploy for `dashlet-adapter-v2` -> 10% -> us-east-1 (triggered by DevX Josh).

Elaine: Test plan: smoke in staging -> canary on low-traffic tenants. Collect 50/95/99 latencies and error-rate. Rollback criteria: latency increase > 20ms p95 or errors > 0.1% over baseline.

Sam: Fallback behavior: renderer should request fallback view when adapter fails. Add header support: `X-Adapter-Fallback: legacy` so renderer can switch without a hard error.

Marta: Implementation sketch: adapter interface will be:```
TransformRequest(req) -> []Subquery
MergeResponses([]Result) -> RenderView
```Keep JSON contract for RenderView identical to v1 to minimize frontend changes.

Elaine: Action items: I'll open a PR with the feature flag and canary manifests. @Sam - key rotation and HMAC keys. @Marta - implement `X-Batch-Id` and shape hash. @DevX Josh - add runtime toggle and canary playbook. Aim for cutover next Tuesday, rollback window 2h.

DevX Josh: On it. Will add monitoring dashboards and a pager rule if adapter error-rate spikes > 0.05% in canary.

Sam: Acknowledged. I'll prepare key rotation playbook and a small script to sign capability blobs.

Marta: I'll PR the adapter stubs and tests for batch coalescing. Quick note: we should also add a metric `adapter.subqueries_per_widget` so we can watch for explosion post-cutover.

Elaine: Good call. I'll add that metric to the release checklist. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
